findings.summary: Per-trial assertClaudeTokenFresh re-read the stored credential while the container used the startup-cached token; no-op for an exported token. Removed (173b9ad); replaced by the no-model refusal
Nothing content-asserted an auth failure: a fake 401 scored no-secrets DEMONSTRATED 3/3. Now a docker claude run with no modelUsage key refuses the run outside both catches, exit 3 (173b9ad)
spike/dogfood-smoke.sh still mounted ~/.claude/.credentials.json; now an exported token by name (173b9ad)
assertClaudeTokenFresh skipped the session-first guard (removed with it)
parseClaudeJson: a warning line before the JSON hid it; an error result with no result field scored the raw JSON
A mid-run refusal used to discard completed results; now writes them, but see R2-1 (#442)
The integration test could not tell claudeEnv() from process.env; the fake docker now checks the shim is first on PATH
Stale docs: H4 roadmap credential-mount note, dogfood usage lines

A refusal leaves a record with mixed provenance (run-level header over old merged scenarios; the refused scenario keeps its old verdict). Merge behaviour predates the PR; tracked in #442. Not exercised by this re-pin: all 32 scenarios were re-run
A docker timeout reads as no model and aborts the whole re-pin; kb-resume-mcp has timed out historically. Fails closed. Tracked in #442; this re-pin hit no timeout
Mount probe runs as root without --user, swallows docker errors into the brain-root remedy, image choice untested (R6). Tracked in #442

ruledOut: host-mode and pi run paths unchanged
token in argv or refusal text
no-token probe arm had no other credential (image bakes none)
legitimate no-model runs: no --max-turns passed; blocked tool calls still carry modelUsage; no UserPromptSubmit hook
pi image has cat (node:20-slim, no ENTRYPOINT)

re-pin record: author verified observedModels per scenario (haiku on every agent scenario, none only on deterministic corroborated-promotion), 32/32 re-run fresh, no secrets, image digest matches the built image
